precincts.name: Grand Canal
precincts.intro: 547 × 5,488 m. Runs the full width of the district, from the Keelway side to the starboard edge, between the bow and stern bands. Eight blocks B1 to B8, port to starboard, cut on the lane lines so none is over 1 km.
